name: Badminton coaching
summary: How expats book badminton coaching in Singapore — hall peak-hour realities, junior group classes, private drills, and gear rental before buying a racket.
body:
Badminton is one of the easiest racket sports to start here — ActiveSG halls, condo courts, and commercial academies all run beginner pathways. Peak evenings book out; morning slots suit shift parents and trailing partners.

## Formats
- Adult beginner group classes
- Private technique drills
- Junior academy pathways
- Holiday clinics
- Casual sparring with coach feed

Court shoes with non-marking soles are usually mandatory.

## How to choose
Prefer coaches who correct footwork before smash volume. Ask whether shuttlecocks and court fees are included. Confirm age bands for mixed junior groups. Rent a racket through the first month — cheap frames break and teach bad habits.

## Practical tip
Book halls as soon as the weekly window opens. Keep a spare grip and water bottle in the car; void-deck humidity destroys unprotected grips.
